section5.1: Original shared CLI actually returned exit 2 unsupported, separately retained. The independently approved task-local wrapper returned exit 0 with no HARD failures on both current full-source hashes. All 45/52 extracted sentences were displayed and read.

section5.3: 926 has 5/45 sentences at or below 8 orthographic units; 927 has 6/52. No paragraph contains more than one sentence above 32 units. Statutory conditions in the long sentences are intact. Useful short steps and procedural limits remain after the author removed generic filler.
section5.4: Read paragraph starts vertically. Maximum repetition is 2: kung/para in 926, kapag/kung in 927. No 3 identical starts or consecutive-start failure.
section5.5: Citation authorities occur within sentences and at endings. No 3 consecutive claim-citation-caveat paragraphs. Both have uncited practical record-comparison paragraphs. Citation links were not trimmed for scores.
section5.6: Automated selected contrast counts are 0; manually inspected unmarked comparisons as well. Document effects, insurance periods and court remedies require distinctions. No repeated decorative contrast or invented opposing reader position remains.
section5.7: 926 ends with which treatment/lost-wage periods are paid and which claims remain. 927 ends with legal service controlling the deadline despite an inquiry. Required service-language limits do not replace those article-specific conclusions.
section5.8: Professional worker-facing Filipino with familiar English work/legal terms and explained Chinese identifiers. No bold, duplicate H1, invented client/experience, public byline, human-review claim or imperative checklist headings. Korean/Japanese register requirements are inapplicable.
section5.9: Compared repairs with affected body and FAQ: 2-year/1-year/5-year origins, conditional 40-month compensation, 10-day appeal/20-day objection/special 20-day suit, settlement validity and stay/security conditions remain distinct. Caption-only normalization was independently reverse-hashed; no body, alt or legal detail changed.

comparators.comparison: Caregiver death and employer transfer, then permit/time-off/abuse/wage consequences. 926 instead interprets two documents for an injured factory worker; 927 identifies debt-court remedies.
A payslip introduces three questions about overtime, deductions and broker fees. Neither new manuscript repeats that three-part opening or payslip-checklist order.
A counted absence condition leads into missing-worker reports, permits, overstay and surrender. 927 addresses debt papers and service, not the immigration consequences of a report.
